verdict.rationale: Glama documents its own per-tool access control on hosted servers ('enable or disable individual tools'). Its Gateway is described as access-controlled, with every MCP call flowing through it so 'you decide what it's allowed to do'. All of this rests on one-line marketing claims. Server-level allowlisting is implied rather than documented, and nothing explains how policies are configured or applied per agent. missing for 10: an explicit server-level allowlist capability, detailed docs on configuring access policies per agent or key, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control
